answer_1.quote: We evaluate our methods on three sets of downstream tasks which require the model to generate long-form outputs (more than 100 tokens) given long-form inputs (more than 10k tokens). (1) long-context summarization tasks: QMSum, GovReport and Novel Summarization and (2) HTML to TSV task from LongProc benchmark.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates long-form generation outputs such as summaries, structured tables (TSV), and synthetic key chains.

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE-L for summarization tasks and row-level F-1 score for the HTML to TSV task.
